justifications.durability: the new surface is guarded: _load swallows a missing or unreadable sidecar, delivered_reports skips a directory missing either file, store_delivered_report raises on a missing report or plan_version, and the store-at-read caller passes over a report the store refuses rather than raising. The one soft spot is that delivered_reports computes each entry's review_run_id from the sidecar's own review_run_id when present while store_delivered_report always writes the report directory's name, so a future sidecar that carries a differing review_run_id would re-store the same report on every read; the current writer never writes that key, so it does not bite today.
justifications.evidence: the four dispatch cases are present and the negative control is real: removing the store-at-read branch reddens test_enforce_mode_stores_a_delivered_report_then_refuses_by_the_finding (negative_control.log, 1 failed, EXIT=1), and re-running the gate in this node's replay of the reviewed worktree reproduces 46 passed, EXIT=0. Two gaps lower it below full: the reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite, so the run's added-failure count reads unmeasured, and gate.log's first line names the base revision rather than the revision it ran at.
justifications.fit: the additions extend the owners the brief names rather than creating beside them, follow the module's existing record and store idiom (write_json_atomically, store_plan_review, read_plan_review), and carry no plan labels, ticket numbers or changelog prose in any new symbol or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the change implements the plan's record side under the names the brief fixes — parse_review_report, review_report_directory, write_review_sidecar, delivered_reports and store_delivered_report — and adds the store-at-read branch the plan names at reckon/crew/routing.py:2585, so a build dispatch with no stored review stores the delivered report whose sidecar carries the plan's fingerprint and judges the result.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 14e314a1..54593fb touches exactly the four declared write paths — reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_plan_review_dispatch.py and the evidence fragment — 556 insertions, no file outside the scope.
